title: Product Manager - Commodity Derivatives
location: Andheri MIDC 10th Floor, Mumbai, Maharashtra , India
jobDescription:
ROLE: Product Manager – Commodity Derivatives

Experience : 4 - 6 Years

Location : Mumbai

Role Overview

We are looking for a dynamic Product Manager to drive the growth and development of our Commodity Derivatives business. The role requires a strong understanding of commodity markets, customer behaviour, product strategy, and business execution. The ideal candidate should be able to identify market opportunities, enhance customer experience, work with cross-functional teams, and execute initiatives that drive product adoption, revenue, and customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute product strategies to increase client acquisition, activation, engagement, and revenue.
  • Identify market opportunities through competitor benchmarking, customer feedback, and industry trends.
  • Work closely with Business, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Research, Marketing, and Sales teams to deliver new product enhancements and initiatives
  • Conceptualize and launch new features, pricing initiatives, campaigns, and value propositions to improve customer experience.
  • Coordinate product launches and ensure successful implementation across all channels.
  • Conduct regular analysis of exchange developments, regulatory changes, and competitor offerings to identify business opportunities.
  • Work closely with branch and digital distribution teams to improve product penetration and customer activation.

Desired Skills

  • Strong understanding of Commodity Derivatives and commodity market ecosystem.
  • Good knowledge of exchange products, trading platforms, margin framework, and market participants.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret business data.

title: Treasury Associate
location: Andheri MIDC 11th Floor, Mumbai, Maharashtra , India
jobDescription:
Job Description – HDFC Securities Limited (Treasury Operations)

Company: HDFC Securities Limited

Location: Andheri MIDC, Mumbai

Department: Treasury

Experience Required: 2–5 years

Role Type: Full-time

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive professional to join our Treasury Operations team. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in treasury processes, money market instruments, accounting, and compliance. This role requires coordination with multiple internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate execution of treasury-related activities.

Key Responsibilities

Treasury Operations

• Handle day-to-day treasury operations, ensuring smooth execution and compliance with internal controls.

• Manage and track maturities, liens, interest payments, and renewals across treasury products.

• Prepare and review documentation for treasury deals, including CP, NCD, G-Sec, Bonds, TREPS, and other money market instruments.

• Generate and publish daily, weekly, and monthly MIS related to treasury activities and ensure timely reconciliations.

• Monitor cash flows, settlements, and positions to support liquidity management.

• Liaise with Credit rating agencies, NSDL, IPA, Investors, custodians, agencies, and internal teams to ensure compliance and timely execution of treasury transactions.

• Coordinate with auditors and provide required data, documentation, and clarifications.

• Adhere to regulatory requirements, internal audit guidelines, and operational risk management standards.

• Support in preparing and maintaining necessary compliance reports and registers.

Accounting & Systems

• Pass and verify accounting entries related to all treasury and finance products with advanced accuracy.

• Work on Treasury Management Systems for deal capture, settlement, and reporting.

• Utilize advanced Excel skills for analytics, reconciliations, and MIS dashboards.

Required Skills & Qualifications

• 2 – 5 years of experience in Treasury Operations/Finance

• Strong understanding of treasury instruments such as CP, NCD, G-sec, Bonds, TREPS, etc.

• Expertise in treasury accounting entries and financial transaction flows.

• Hands-on experience with Treasury Management Systems.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

• Excellent coordination, communication, and documentation skills.

• Ability to work under tight timelines with strong attention to detail.

title: UX Researcher
location: Andheri MIDC 10th Floor, Mumbai, Maharashtra , India
jobDescription:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Passionate about understanding users and shaping great digital experiences? Join our UX Research team!

About HDFC Securities:

HDFC Securities is one of the leading financial services companies in India, providing a wide range of investment and trading services. With a strong presence in both the B2B and B2C sectors, HDFC Securities caters to millions of users through its various digital platforms and applications.

What you’ll do:

· Plan and conduct UX research studies from start to finish, including exploratory, generative, and usability research for HDFC Securities product experiences.

· Work closely with product managers, designers, and researchers to understand research needs and support design improvements.

· Turn research findings into clear insights, recommendations, and user stories.

· Use data from product analytics, past research, and user feedback to strengthen research findings.

· Explore and use AI tools to make research processes faster and improve team efficiency.

What we’re looking for:

· Minimum 2 years of UX research experience with digital product teams.

· Bachelor’s degree in a research-related field or equivalent work experience.

· Curious, analytical, and user-focused mindset

· Strong communication and storytelling skills

· Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and adjust to changing priorities.

· Experience with AI tools and Fin Tech is a plus

Location: Andheri, Mumbai

If this sounds like you, or you know someone who’d be a great fit, we’d love to connect!

title: Digital Campaign Manager
location: Andheri MIDC 10th Floor, Mumbai, Maharashtra , India
jobDescription:
Job Description: Assistant Manager - Marketing
Experience Required: 3 to 5 Years
Target Industries: Fin Tech, Stockbroking, Wealth Tech, or BFSI (preferred)
Location: Mumbai

Key Responsibilities
Campaign Execution & Optimization: Design, execute, and optimize multi-channel campaigns (Email, Whats App, RCS, Push Notifications, In-App) specifically geared towards generating quality leads and driving conversions.
Persona & Audience Strategy: Work closely with internal and external teams to build compelling, personalized campaigns tailored to diverse consumer segments.
Vernacular & Regional Customization: Oversee regional/vernacular adaptations of marketing communications to ensure high resonance across different customer backgrounds and tiers across India.
Funnel Analytics: Monitor and analyze the end-to-end user journey from initial click/install and lead stage right through to final conversion.
Performance Reporting: Track and publish comprehensive performance reports detailing key performance indicators (KPIs), focusing on click-to-lead and lead-to-conversion metrics for respective campaigns and channels.
Stakeholder Coordination: Act as the primary bridge between key cross-functional stakeholders to ensure a swift, seamless, and compliant rollout of all campaigns.

Required Candidate Profile
EDUCATION: Graduate / Postgraduate in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related quantitative field.
Tech & AI Tool Proficiency:Must have working knowledge and practical experience using MS Office, AI tools (such as Claude, Gemini, Copilot, etc.)
Experience: 3 to 6 years of proven track record in digital marketing, product growth, or campaign lifecycle management. Direct experience in the fintech or stockbroking domain is a significant advantage.
Skillset & Execution: Good written and verbal communication skills with a strong eye for analytical detail. Must possess a knack for quick thinking and rapid execution without compromising on quality.
Mindset: A proactive, focused individual who can quickly grasp complex guidelines and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced digital ecosystem.

title: Product Manager
location: Andheri MIDC 10th Floor, Mumbai, Maharashtra , India
jobDescription:
Product Manager – Trading Platform


Location:Mumbai (Andheri MIDC)


About the Role


HDFC Securities is building the next generation of trading and investing experiences across Mobile and Web. We are looking for an experienced Product Manager who understands the needs of active traders and investors and can translate business problems into intuitive digital products.


You will own key journeys across the trading lifecycle—from discovery to execution and portfolio management—while working closely with Engineering, Design, QA, Business, Marketing, Growth, and Analytics teams.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong product thinking with deep broking domain knowledge and an obsession for customer experience.


Key RESPONSIBILITIES:


- Own product lifecycle from discovery to launch.

- Manage key trading modules such as Watchlist, Order Pad, Order Book, Positions, Portfolio, Funds and Reports.

- Prepare PRDs, user stories, wireframes and processflows.

- Work closely with Tech, QA, Design, Business, Marketing and Growthteams.

- Drive product decisions using customer insights, analytics and data.

- Monitor feature performance and continuously improve user experience.


Requirements:


- 3–4 years of Product Management experience in a Stock Broking platform.

- Strong understanding of Equity, Derivatives and Mutual Funds.

- Experience with Mobile and Web tradingproducts.

- Good understanding of trading charts.

- Hands-on experience with APIs, JIRA and Agile methodologies.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


Preferred


- Experience with Client APIs, Algo Trading and Whats App integrations.

- Exposure to personalization, analytics tracking and data-driven product development.


Who We're Looking For?


A smart, collaborative and customer-focused Product Manager with excellent communication skills, strong ownership, and the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams to build best-in-class trading experiences.

title: Application Support Lead
jobDescription:
Application Support Lead


Roles & RESPONSIBILITIES:


  1. Understanding on technical and functional aspects of business.
  2. Responsible for application up time & incident management for defined IT applications.
  3. Have experience to deploy applications running under LINUX /Windows OS, including configuration, troubleshooting, and automation.
  4. Must know shell scripting, dos batch commands, power shell scripting.
  5. Working Knowledge of Active Directory, DNS, Windows & Linux Operating System. Have basic networks knowledge – like telnet, netstat ipconfig/ifconfig, nslookup/dig for DNS resolution, traceroute/tracert, A record, CNAME FQDN etc.
  6. Co-ordinating with different teams to Identifying the root causes of incidents in order to prevent future recurrence
  7. Knowledge of REST API, XML API, SQL Server, Oracle will be added advantage.
  8. Responsible for deployment & movement of application code / bug fixes / data patches and release management in Production, SIT and UAT environments in coordination with vendors
  9. Deployment of software applications and tools


Work Experience:


  1. 10 years’ experience in supporting IT infra in a high-volume and critical environment.
  2. Hands on experience in the area of installation, configuration, monitoring and management of Applications & Databases in Linux & Windows.
  3. Experience in application server log analysis, troubleshooting, management and problem solving.
  4. Basic Networking knowledge, should be able to troubleshoot issues with minimum guidance and support
  5. Problem solving skills
  6. Individual Contributor


Soft Skills:


  1. Ability to prioritize effectively and handle shifting priorities professionally
  2. Good written and oral communications skills
  3. Good inter-personal skills
  4. Must possess strong quantitative, and analytical skills
